result.planSummary: Fixed SV-03-003 by making lower-band artifact persistence retry transient STORE_UNAVAILABLE failures in addition to stale revisions, with short backoff, so async detailed/brief background compression can survive file-backed mutation races without blocking the deterministic close path. Hardened the affected tests to simulate the verifier's brief-ready write failure and to assert the real nonblocking invariant without brittle full-suite timing assumptions.

changedFiles.reason: Treats STORE_UNAVAILABLE as retryable during lower-band artifact persistence and retries with short backoff so transient thread mutation failures do not abort background compression.
Injects the verifier-observed transient STORE_UNAVAILABLE failure on the brief ready write and proves scheduled async compression still persists detailed and brief ready artifacts.
Replaces a brittle 25ms full-suite timing assertion with the actual invariant that maintenance completes before the blocked provider is released.

gatesRun.command: node --import tsx --test --test-name-pattern '^normal async maintenance schedules semantic lower-band compression on chunk close without waiting on model latency$' tests/thread/async-thread-run-service.test.ts

findingsFixed: SV-03-003: Background lower-band artifact persistence now retries transient STORE_UNAVAILABLE thread mutation failures, matching the verifier failure mode where brief generation could remain undefined after a temporary write failure.
The affected chunk-close scheduling test now explicitly reproduces the transient brief-ready write failure and proves both detailed and brief become ready without weakening async close requirements.
The async maintenance nonblocking test now asserts maintenance resolves while provider latency is still blocked, avoiding a nondeterministic 25ms timing race under full-suite load.

result.recommendedNextStep: Return to verifier for SV-03-003 follow-up verification.
